attributes.action: Require CCTV in special schools, classrooms and nurseries with SEND children
attributes.additional_details: Many children with SEND are non-verbal or struggle to communicate when something goes wrong. Parents deserve reassurance that their children are safe. CCTV inside special schools, classrooms and nurseries supporting SEND children could help investigate any safeguarding concerns, protect vulnerable children and staff, and provide evidence when incidents occur. Cameras should have strict privacy safeguards, with secure recordings accessible only to authorised people. Every child deserves protection, especially those who cannot speak for themselves.
attributes.background: We want the UK Government to require CCTV cameras inside special schools, and classrooms and nurseries supporting children with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND), especially non-verbal children who cannot report incidents. Recordings must be secure and protect children's privacy.
